results.title: BRITTLE HOME MOVIE 1997
results.overview: This is the only film reel my father ever shot in the place where I spent my childhood. Unfortunately, almost nothing remains: the memories of a bonfire in our garden back home, captured on film in ’97, now worn away by time.  A whirl of aquamarine blue dances wildly, occasionally allowing me a glimpse of something hidden beneath layers of melted and corroded emulsion.  The flames trapped within the frames vanish, submerged beneath layers of moisture.

results.title: Jean
results.overview: Over the course of eight years, the film draws an intimate portrait of Jean Ciesielski, a teenager growing up in Antwerp. Moving through a succession of schools and educational tracks, Jean searches for a place within a system that has defined him from a young age. At twelve years old, he speaks about his situation with a striking maturity and clarity. As he gets older, Jean feels an increasing urgency for change. Unable to obtain a regular secondary school diploma within his current track, he decides to change schools once more. His journey reveals how strongly the language and expectations of education have shaped the way he sees himself and his place in society.

results.title: Casa Propia
results.overview: In the office she uses as her home, Susana, a retired mother, is portrayed by her child, Conam, a non-binary filmmaker. As they talk, they move through shared memories and concerns, while longing for the place where Susana dreams of spending her old age.

results.title: Andhkar
results.overview: Andhkar is a suspense thriller about the murder of a famous painter's wife in her bungalow. Set over one night from 6 p.m. to 6 a.m., it is a classic murder mystery where nothing is as it seems.

results.title: Some Time
results.overview: Andrés and Emma took a break from their relationship just days before their first anniversary together. To avoid being alone, he spends that evening at a friend's family dinner, unsure of what to do. There, he discusses his situation with his friend's colorful relatives, reminiscing about his relationship.

results.title: Yuen Long Knight
results.overview: The story explores Yuen Long's drug problem and its resulting generational trauma from a unique perspective— a “superhero" is someone who’s willing to shoulder greater responsibility than others.  The story is told from the perspective of an older sister who returns to her old home years later for her graduation thesis, getting to know her younger brother after their parents' divorce -old memories resurface at the place she once lived. Meanwhile, the younger brother is about to risk everything to save his friend who is trapped in a drug network. Can old wounds be healed and relationships reconciled?

results.title: Antes de Cambiar
results.overview: Carolina and Lucas are a couple celebrating their first anniversary. On their way to the place where they met, Carolina begins to have doubts about their relationship, the changes within herself, and what the future holds.

results.title: Chronicles of the Inconvenient Truth
results.overview: In 1986 the Chernobyl disaster happened. This documentary tells the story of how the Bulgarian government hid the disaster consequences from the people, while ordering radiation-free food and water from abroad for the highest echelon of the Central Committee.

results.title: Black Water
results.overview: 19-year-old Noah, who's living with his mom and sister in an old, dilapidated house on the outskirts of Boston, is sitting in therapy, as he's suffering from dark and potentially dangerous visions at night. During one of his sessions, he's asked to revisit some of these visions, forcing him back to a time of horror and distress.
